sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 6x6x6 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 5. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (5-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,5-z,y).
Apply rotations Z+, Z+, X+, X+ in order. Where does beacon B finish?
A. (1, 3, 4)
B. (4, 1, 3)
C. (4, 4, 2)
D. (2, 4, 3)
E. (1, 5, 3)
F. (1, 4, 3)
sample.analysis: Start beacon B at (4, 4, 2). Applying ['Z+', 'Z+', 'X+', 'X+'] successively gives (1, 4, 3). The answer is F.
